newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 597 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 597 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totaled 597 contracts, compared with 473 contracts traded overnight Thursday.
There were 50 wheat, 367 corn, 146 soybean, three oat, two rough rice, 27 soymeal, one soyoil and one corn call traded.
In overnight trading, corn was steady to one cent lower, soybeans 1-1/2 to three cents lower and wheat 3-3/4 to 4-1/4 cents lower.
